Adds an opt-out for the taller toolbar row, for anyone who prefers JDownloader's stock compact layout.

## ✨ Added
- New `JD_COMPACT_TOOLBAR` environment variable. `true` / `1` keeps JDownloader's stock ~32px toolbar row; empty or `false` keeps this image's default of growing the row to 64px so the download speed graph has full height. Contributed by [@milfer322](https://github.com/milfer322) in [#18](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/jdownloader/pull/18), following up on [#16](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/jdownloader/issues/16).
